summary: Frontend-only test of the JujuCloud-styled CloudIVR landing (1920px + 390px), English and French, plus logged-in app (Alice) in dark and light themes on Overview/Numbers/Settings. Nearly everything works: hero, the HeroCard tabs and CTAs, NumbersPreview, PromiseStrip, FeaturePills, FAQ, FinalCta, the plan tabs and the compare table. 4 issues found: (1) the French translation is missing for the new hero kicker, title and cycling words, and subtitle (mixed EN/FR); (2) the landing FAQ chevron rotates 45deg instead of 180deg because of an old landing rule; (3) the new blue-to-lime active nav gradient never shows in the sidebar because a more specific rule wins; (4) the eSIM CTA goes to /signup?plan=esim instead of opening a dialog, because the preview /public/esim-plans returns an empty plans list (by-design fallback).

minor.issue: Returns {plans: []} on preview, so EsimCheckoutHost falls back to navigating to /signup?plan=esim. The eSIM checkout dialog cannot be opened on preview (environment/data, not a code bug).

ui_bugs.issue: When an item is open the chevron rotates 45deg (computed matrix 0.707), so the ChevronDown looks like a tilted 'L'. Cause: cloudivr.css:194 `.civr .civr-l details[open] .civr-faq-chevron { transform: rotate(45deg) }`, left over from the old plus icon, overrides cloudivr.css:105 rotate(180deg). Fix: change it to rotate(180deg) or remove it.

The new `html[data-civr-theme] .civr .civr-nav-link.active::before { background: linear-gradient(...#a3e635) }` (theme-clean.css:161) is overridden by the more specific theme-clean.css:70 `.civr-side .civr-nav-link.active::before { background:#64acff }`. Computed: backgroundImage none, solid rgb(100,172,255). Fix: add .civr-side to the new selector or update line 70.

integration_issues.issue: These new strings have no fr/es keys and come out mixed EN/FR: kicker 'Cloud phone, IVR and USA mobile lines' -> 'Cloud phone, IVR et USA mobile lines'; title 'One place for' plus the cycling words 'business calls', 'IVR campaigns', 'two-way texts', 'a USA eSIM' (rendered as 'One place for two-way SMS'); subtitle 'Pick what you need, pay with crypto or your wallet, and you are live in minutes. Month to month, no contract' -> 'Pick what you need, ... et you are live in minutes...'. The HeroCard, trust items, preview, strip, pills and final CTA translate fine. Minor: the preview badge 'Running' -> 'en cours' is lowercase while the other badges are capitalised ('Actif', 'Enregistré'). Spanish (es.json) is missing the same keys.

issues: Large empty gap (~100px) between the NumbersPreview pipeline and the dark promise strip, and between the FAQ and the final CTA (FAQ py-20 + final py-24); consider tightening it. Not blocking.

passed_checks: Desktop hero: cycling word changes every ~2.6s; lime squiggle (rgb 163,230,53) under the word; 4 hero-decor drawings visible at 1920px with no overlap with the title or card
Mobile 390px: decor hidden; no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth 390; only the platform tab scroller extends, by design); hero card tabs 103x52 with no clipping
Hero card: ivr/esim/mobile tabs switch panels, aria-selected, pitch and price ($50/$75/$75) and labels ('See phone plans'/'Order eSIM'/'See details')
hero-card-cta-ivr scrolls #pricing to the top (63px) and selects plans-tab-ivr; mobile CTA (offer.available=false) scrolls to pricing with plans-tab-mobile selected and plans-panel-mobile shown
hero-try-link and final-cta-try-button scroll to #try; hero-trust-0..2 visible
NumbersPreview: 4 rows with badges Active/Registered/Running/Active; pipeline steps advance done 0->3 and loop while in view
PromiseStrip: bg rgb(7,6,15), headlines lime/pink/sky/blue, sub text rgb(203,213,225); readable
FeaturePills: 14 pills (0..13), pink circled 'and more' rgb(236,72,153)
FAQ: 10 items open/close, answers slate-600 readable
FinalCta: white h2, final-cta-button href /cloudivr/signup navigates correctly
Plans tabs and compare table (7 rows) still work; language switched back to English
App (Alice) dark+light: Overview/Numbers/Settings render, .civr-btn-primary radius 12px with blue glow shadow, no page errors (only the known 401 auth probes)
action_items: Add fr.json and es.json keys for 'Cloud phone, IVR and USA mobile lines', 'One place for', 'business calls', 'IVR campaigns', 'two-way texts', 'a USA eSIM' and the hero subtitle sentence (check how the engine splits the dynamic ' · from $X/month' suffix)
Fix the landing FAQ chevron rotation: cloudivr.css:194 rotate(45deg) -> rotate(180deg)
Make the sidebar active marker gradient win over theme-clean.css:70 (specificity)
Optional: capitalise the 'Running' translation ('En cours' / 'En ejecución')
critical_code_review_comments: theme-clean.css new accent rules depend on cascade order but lose to the earlier, more specific .civr-side rules; check every new override for specificity
HeroCard's PITCH/SHORT/TRUST strings were added to the i18n JSON, but the OneHero strings in OnePage.js were not
seed_data_creation: None. Nothing purchased; no data changed. The eSIM CTA went to the signup page and nothing was submitted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing at /cloudivr. Preview /api/cloudivr-web/public/esim-plans returns empty plans (eSIM CTA -> /signup?plan=esim); mobile-offer available=false. Theme stored in localStorage 'civr.theme'. Login: cookie-allow-all, auth-email-input, input[type=password], auth-submit-button. Alice wallet now shows $9.38 (not $380).
